items.title: Blackstone weighs scrapping $3bn ’Project Eclipse’ CFO, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: The structured deal, code-named Project Eclipse, was designed to pool roughly 700 underlying investments from one of Blackstone’s older secondaries funds and issue rated debt tranches against them. Such instruments, known as CFOs, allow fixed-income investors including insurers to gain exposure to private capital funds through more familiar debt securities. Jefferies Financial Group has been advising Blackstone on the transaction, according to Bloomberg’s sources.
